name: Github-desktop
tagline: An open source Electron-based GitHub app. It is written in TypeScript and uses React.
description: Github Desktop is an open source Electron-based GitHub app. It is written in TypeScript and uses React.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/github-desktop:3.4.13@sha256:8651e12fa3c6418b3a6f1a745ec629e9923294c52a653a87d81983a4bbaeba07
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
